steps.instruction: Calibrate your view and complete the safety check.
steps.hint: Look straight ahead and press Recenter on the calibration panel.
It is the grey panel on your left with the yellow POWER label.
Press the flashing ACK button under the warning light.
Select the CHECKLIST tab on the screen above the panel.

steps.instruction: Find the power bus that has the fault.
steps.hint: The caution message names the faulted bus. Select the bus whose FAULT light is lit.

steps.instruction: Move the Bus B selector to ISOLATE.
steps.hint: Turn the Bus B dial until it points at ISOLATE.
Push the CROSS-TIE breaker in until it clicks.

steps.instruction: Check that the system shows RESTORED, then report.
steps.hint: When the status light is green, press REPORT on the comms panel.
